workflow.name: audit
workflow.description: Audit a repository, a branch or recent commits across quality categories: recon, narrow parallel hunts, adversarial validation, gap-fill, dedupe, impact assessment, saved report

input.name: categories
input.description: Comma-separated: correctness security performance reliability maintainability architecture testing compatibility usability operability (or all)

input.name: paths
input.description: Git pathspec limiting the audit (default: the whole repository)

input.name: passes
input.description: Maximum hunt passes; later passes only cover gaps reported by earlier ones

input.name: scope
input.description: What to audit: repo (every tracked file), branch:BASE (changes since BASE, e.g. branch:main), or commits:N (the last N commits)

run.cmd: sh -c 'case $1 in repo) printf repo;; branch:*) printf %s ${1#branch:}...HEAD;; commits:*) printf %s HEAD~${1#commits:}..HEAD;; *) printf %s unknown-scope-use-repo-branch:BASE-or-commits:N; exit 2;; esac' range {{scope}}
sh -c 'if [ $2 = repo ]; then git ls-files -- $1; else git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d $2 -- $1; fi' files {{paths}} {{range.output}}
echo no files in scope: nothing changed in {{range.output}} under {{paths}}. Try scope=commits:N or branch:BASE from another branch.

output.name: summary
output.value: Audited {{range.output}}: {{assess | compact | count}} findings {{assess | compact | count_by:properties.priority | json}}, {{gaps.tasks | count}} uncovered areas. Report: {{saved_report}}
